sections.title: GM06 v1 Inputs And Dependencies
sections.text: Reuse the shapes.py schema: name, plane (XY default, also XZ/YZ or native construction plane), geometry and optional constraints/dimensions/positions. frame is sketch, schemaVersion is 1. Named ellipse accepts center plus majorRadius/minorRadius/angle? OR majorAxisPoint/minorAxisPoint; endpoints must be perpendicular and major radius > minor radius > 0. Radii are half full axis lengths. Coordinates are length-expression triples in sketch-local XY, not root coordinates. Ellipse .majorAxis/.minorAxis selectors resolve native axis lines for angular dimensions; .center resolves the center. Rectangle .edge0..edge3 and endpoints are available. Existing line/arc/arc3/circle/point/spline/Bezier formats remain. All names and helper names must be unused. Parametric history is required for positions.

sections.title: Center And Inference
sections.text: positions:[{name,point:localSelector,coordinates:[x,y,0]}] creates existing expression-driven datum-point helpers and a linked projection/coincidence. Signed parameter coordinates can cross zero; unsigned distance dimensions cannot substitute for these bindings. The actual native sketch frame, including XZ/YZ signs, supplies sampled affine coefficients; support-plane frame changes require reviewing/rebuilding the binding. inferencePolicy explicit(default)|native records whether only explicit fmcad constraints or native primitive constraints are intended. Both preserve inherent SDK constraints and neither changes global UI preferences; no public inference toggle is claimed. See docs/GM06.md.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, success/status/operation/documentIdentity, sketch:Ref, refs:{label:Ref|Ref[]}, profiles:[{kind:profile,sketch:Ref,index}], isFullyConstrained, units:{length:cm,angle:rad}, frame:{space:sketch,sketch:Ref}, associativity, warnings, method, limitations and provenance. Explicit dimensions retain nativeExpression; constraints and linked positions nativeReference; raw geometry is snapshot. Use result.sketch and result.profiles[i] downstream after inspection. Created refs are in the standard envelope. Build/solver failure can leave partial geometry; no rollback/save/deletion to repair constraints.

examples.label: Dimensioned ellipse on XZ
examples.requires: An open parametric Model with no GM06Oval name collision; native selected component. Native solver/loft acceptance remains open.
examples.output: result.refs.oval identifies the ellipse; result.profiles[0] is usable by loft only after the native profile exists and is inspected.

verified: Shared builder schema and parser reachability
Offline ellipse SDK signatures, radius units and native-axis selectors

sections.title: Frame And Order
sections.text: Requires sketch, unique entities refs and frame:sketch. Supply translate:[length expressions] and/or rotate:{angle,center?}. Center defaults to local origin; z must be zero. Right-handed rotation about sketch +Z precedes local XY translation, including XZ/YZ supports. Uses native Sketch.move(ObjectCollection,Matrix3D), not copies or occurrence transforms. Supports planar points, lines, circular curves, ellipses and fitted splines. Rejects scaling, reflection and arbitrary matrices.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result includes GM06 schemaVersion/status/documentIdentity/units/frame/associativity:snapshot/provenance, before/after whole-sketch states, affected refs, conflicts, matrix and order. Fixed/reference/fully constrained selected entities produce blocked with unchanged before/after. Solver refusal, exception, unhealthy result or mismatched point/ellipse-direction readback produces fail with actual before/after. No constraint deletion, automatic retry, save or rollback; partial changes can remain. Native XZ/YZ acceptance is open.

examples.label: Rotate and translate discovered curve
examples.requires: Alias a free ellipse in Section as SeedEllipse using its actual returned ref, or substitute the ref directly. Do not use a response label as a persistent alias.
examples.output: On success local geometry is rotated first, then shifted -5 mm in sketch X; before/after and solver conflicts are returned.

verified: Rigid local transform ordering and solver-return readback using SDK fakes

sections.title: Recognition Time Budget
sections.text: maxSeconds defaults to 10, positive and at most 120 seconds. The bounded plan checks elapsed time between SDK reads and inside recognition loops; it cannot interrupt a single blocking SDK read. The number of requested relations is also bounded by maxEntities. result.work includes elapsedSeconds, maxSeconds and candidatePairsUpperBound. Budget failure occurs without model mutation.

sections.title: Read-only Recognition
sections.text: Requires a native sketch; optional entities narrow curve recognition. maxEntities is 1..1000, default 200. tolerance defaults 0.000001 cm, positive and at most 0.01 cm. Recognizes circles, ellipses and isolated four-line rectangles, including rotated rectangles; branches are not guessed. Optional relations:[{type,entities}] explicitly requests supported relations. Actual native constraint/dimension properties and resolved entity equality suppress duplicates; radius/diameter and opposite rectangle-side dimensions are recognized. Driven dimensions conservatively suppress duplicates without being converted. Unknown constraint types remain reported. Planning creates no geometry, attributes or dimensions and CLI dispatches readOnly:true.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result includes the GM06 envelope, mutation:false, plan:{schemaVersion:1,documentIdentity,sketch,fingerprint,options,proposals:[{id,operation,reason,data}]}, recognized, existing, skipped, unrecognizedConstraints, work and coverage. Copy the exact result.plan into sketch.dimension-apply.plan and select proposal IDs explicitly. The fingerprint is a conservative snapshot of geometry/constraints/dimension expressions; token representation changes may invalidate it. This is a reviewable proposal list, not a solver feasibility certificate or an approval of dimension independence.

examples.label: Review current sketch
examples.requires: Existing Section containing intended circle/rectangle/ellipse geometry. This call is read-only, does not activate a document or recompute.
examples.output: Review result.plan.proposals and result.existing. A fully dimensioned recognized sketch has no new size proposals.

verified: Real SDK property names, aliases, existing dimension recognition and rotated rectangle math in fakes

sections.title: Reviewed Application
sections.text: Requires sketch, the exact plan returned by sketch.dimension-plan and a nonempty unique accept array of proposal IDs. No implicit accept-all. Rechecks document identity, same native sketch, state fingerprint and regenerated proposals before any mutation. Changed/tampered/stale plans are rejected. Accepted dimensions are validated as a group before writes. The CLI dispatches readOnly:false; constraints are never deleted to resolve conflicts.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result includes GM06 status/documentIdentity/units/frame/associativity, before/after, completed:[{id,result}], conflicts:[{id,error}], notApplied:[id], affected refs and atomic:false. Stops at the first solver conflict; completed geometry can remain. Re-plan after applying: new plans recognize the newly created dimensions and skip duplicates. Old plans are not replayed automatically. NativeExpression applies to dimensions; constraint-only proposals create nativeReference constraints.

examples.label: Apply one reviewed proposal in a batch
examples.requires: Earlier batch step review invoked sketch.dimension-plan for Section and returned proposal p1; a human reviewed that exact result. For standalone use substitute the actual result.plan object, never invent tokens/fingerprint.
examples.output: result.completed contains p1 if accepted by the native solver; failures expose conflicts and notApplied without deleting constraints.

verified: Partial failure ledger and repeat-plan deduplication with SDK fakes
